title: Approve 2027/28 room rent schedule
detail: The University proposes a 3.5% rise in weekly rents for the 2027/28 contract year, in line with the lease's index cap. Simple majority of senior and ordinary units, 30% quorum.

title: First quarterly income distribution
detail: Senior units first under the waterfall, ordinary units from the balance. Paid in GBP by SWIFT, or in USDC on request.

title: Daily NAV struck at 1.0458
detail: NAV calculated by Apex Group and published on-chain by Chainlink across 4 networks.

title: Periodic distribution of USD 27.00 per certificate
detail: Semi-annual profit at 5.40% a year on USD 1,000 face value, from the Ijara rentals.

title: Scheduled dissolution
detail: Dissolution at face value with the final periodic distribution.

title: Q4 2026 quarterly repurchase offer
detail: The fund offers to repurchase up to 5% of units at the December NAV. Requests are pro-rated if oversubscribed.

title: Q3 investor letter and capital account statements
detail: Statements generated for all unit holders and delivered to the investor portal.

title: Semi-annual bar audit completed
detail: Inspectorate counted 27 bars at Brink's Dubai and matched serial numbers and weights to the register. No differences.

title: Q3 dividend from net rent
detail: AED 0.159 per share, paid to the bank account or wallet on file.

title: Sponsor liquidity facility
detail: The sponsor will buy up to 2% of shares at NAV after the 90-day lock-up.

title: Redemption at par
detail: Each note is redeemed at 100. No interim payments.

title: Final maturity
detail: Final interest and principal from collected receivables.
